sections.name: File setup, doc
sections.title: Sample source and fixed quote
sections.what: Imports the modules under test and builds a sample source document containing a fixed quote.
sections.why: Gives every later check the same known source text.
sections.watch_out: Changing the sample quote changes the results of many checks.

sections.name: finding
sections.title: Grounding a sample finding
sections.what: Builds a sample finding and checks that it passes the schema and is grounded. Also checks that confidence drops to medium with one domain, and that invented or unfetched sources are rejected.
sections.why: Confirms the app will not show findings whose evidence is missing or fake.
sections.watch_out: A stricter matching rule could reject real findings that differ only in small wording details.

sections.name: assistantPool
sections.title: Citations, legacy scoring and database checks
sections.what: Checks assistant citations, rejects blocked-page text, checks that legacy scores match the card score and that private routing is not sent out. Then, inside a database transaction, checks that dismissed reviews survive updates and that only one research job is queued per industry, then rolls back.
sections.why: Likely reason: the review decisions are saved by people, so they must survive later updates. Otherwise not stated in the code.
sections.watch_out: The database steps write to the real database during the run, so a failed rollback leaves rows behind.

summary: Tests the opportunity map: quote grounding, source failure handling, confidence rules, assistant citations, queue deduplication, and saved review decisions in the database.
purpose: Makes sure findings appear only when backed by real quotes from fetched sources, and that the review queue behaves correctly.
why: Likely reason: the product must not show unsupported claims as facts.
how: Checks a sample finding against a sample source: schema, grounding, medium confidence with one domain, rejection of invented or unfetched sources, and tolerance for extra spaces in quotes. Then checks assistant citations, rejects blocked-page text, checks the legacy score and that private routing is not sent out. Last, inside a database transaction, checks that a dismissed review survives an update and that only one job is queued per industry, then rolls back.
inputs: Sample documents and findings in the file, the research, types, assistant evidence, deck research and store modules, and the database.
outputs: A PASS line, or a failure. Database test rows are rolled back.
risks: The database test writes rows during the run. If the rollback fails, test rows may remain. Fixed IDs are used.
debug: If grounding checks fail, check groundFinding and the quote matching. If the job check fails, check the conflict rule on the opportunity_jobs insert.
